methodology.network: Publisher computer current network; not a phone or campus measurement
methodology.notes: End-to-end HTTP transfer including DNS/TLS/redirects; API includes metadata lookup; native DNS lookup may outlast abort timer. Three passes reuse the HTTP client connection pool; files validated against pinned RSA public key and signed baseline SHA256/size.
methodology.ordering: Verified successes descending, then median complete verified transfer milliseconds ascending; unmeasured nodes before all-failure fallback.
